THE WEDSPARKS GUIDE

Questions to Ask Before Booking a Wedding Venue

A beautiful space is a starting point. These questions help you understand how it will work for your day.

Start your wedding planExplore suppliers

By WedSparks · Wedding planning guide

01

Will the space fit your plans?

Ask about seated and standing capacity, ceremony arrangements, accessibility, parking and accommodation. Check whether your guest count includes children and supplier meals where relevant.

02

What is included in the quote?

Ask about furniture, linen, staffing, catering, equipment, setup and pack-down. Clarify minimum numbers or spend, additional hours and any stated external-supplier charges.

03

What happens if the weather changes?

Walk through the indoor option and understand who decides when to move. Ask about heating, shade and access between spaces.

04

How will suppliers work on the day?

Confirm access times, loading areas, power, storage and site rules. Ask who will be your main contact and what information suppliers need before arriving.

05

What should be confirmed before you commit?

Read the proposed agreement and ask for clarification about payment dates, changes, cancellations and what has been promised. Keep written confirmations with your planning documents.
